about: President Oedipus's flowers (Elm, 1 Oct 2026: "a succession of flowers around the city that wilt when you open them and they're all sections of president oedipus, but you gotta click them in order"; a trial: plants). One for each of the five parts the essay divides itself into with its own '. . .' (essays/president-oedipus.html, #part-1 to #part-5; its note goes with the last). Each stands where the city already held a passage from its part (the gas station, the sun-dock, the edge), or on the way between (the Steel Garden, the cafés' quay). droop: the way it bows as it wilts (radians round y from +z). floats: on the bay's water.
